questions.stem: 函数$f(x)=\frac{x^2 - x}{|x|(x^2 - 1)}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}}$的无穷间断点的个数为
questions.answer: C
questions.explanation:
解析 由已知，$x=0$，$x=\pm1$，$x=2$是$f(x)$的间断点．

由

$\lim\limits_{x \to 0^+}\frac{x^2 - x}{x(x^2 - 1)}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = \lim\limits_{x \to 0^+}\frac{1}{x + 1}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = \text{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}$，

$\lim\limits_{x \to 0^-}\frac{x^2 - x}{-x(x^2 - 1)}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = \lim\limits_{x \to 0^-}\frac{-1}{x + 1}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = -\text{e}^{-\frac{1}{2}}$，

知$x = 0$是$f(x)$的跳跃间断点．

由$\lim\limits_{x \to 1}\frac{x^2 - x}{x(x^2 - 1)}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = \frac{1}{2}\text{e}^{-1}$，知$x = 1$是$f(x)$的可去间断点．

由

$\lim\limits_{x \to -1}\frac{x(x - 1)}{-x(x - 1)(x + 1)}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = \lim\limits_{x \to -1}\frac{-1}{x + 1}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = \infty$，

$\lim\limits_{x \to 2^+}\frac{x^2 - x}{x(x^2 - 1)}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = \lim\limits_{x \to 2^+}\frac{1}{x + 1}\text{e}^{\frac{1}{x - 2}} = +\infty$，

知$x = -1$，$2$是$f(x)$的无穷间断点．无穷间断点有$2$个．

选项 C 正确．

questions.stem: 设当$x \to 0$时，有$\cot x = \frac{1 + ax^2}{x + bx^3} + o(x^5)$，则
questions.answer: C
questions.explanation:
解析 由$\cot x = \frac{\cos x}{\sin x} = \frac{1 + ax^2}{x + bx^3} + o(x^5)$，

得$(x + bx^3)\cos x = (1 + ax^2)\sin x + o(x^7)$．

由泰勒公式，有

$(x + bx^3)\left(1 - \frac{x^2}{2!} + \frac{x^4}{4!} + o(x^6)\right) = (1 + ax^2)\left(x - \frac{x^3}{3!} + \frac{x^5}{5!} + o(x^7)\right) + o(x^7)$

即$x - \frac{x^3}{2!} + \frac{x^5}{4!} + o(x^7) + bx^3 - b \cdot \frac{x^5}{2} = x - \frac{x^3}{3!} + \frac{x^5}{5!} + o(x^7) + ax^3 - \frac{ax^5}{6} + o(x^7)$

故

$\begin{cases}

-\frac{1}{2} + b = a - \frac{1}{6}, \\

\frac{1}{24} - \frac{b}{2} = \frac{1}{120} - \frac{a}{6},

\end{cases}$

解得$a = -\frac{2}{5}, b = -\frac{1}{15}$，

选项C正确．

questions.stem: 下列函数在点\( P_0(0,0) \)处不可微，且\( f'_x(x,y) \)在点\( P_0 \)的邻域内有界的是
questions.answer: D
questions.explanation:
解析 对于选项A:\( f'_x(0,0)=\lim\limits_{x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x,0)-f(0,0)}{x}=0 \)，同理，\( f'_y(0,0)=0 \).由于

\( \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{f(x,y)-f(0,0)-\left[f'_x(0,0)x + f'_y(0,0)y\right]}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} = \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\sqrt{\dfrac{|xy|}{x^2+y^2}} \)不存在

（取\( y=kx \)，\( \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y=kx \to 0}}\sqrt{\dfrac{|xy|}{x^2+y^2}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{|k|}{1+k^2}} \)与\( k \)有关），

故\( f(x,y)=\sqrt{|xy|} \)在点\( P_0(0,0) \)处不可微.由

\( f'_x(x,y)=\dfrac{1}{2}\sqrt{\left|\dfrac{y}{x}\right|} \cdot \text{sgn}(x)(x \neq 0) \)，\( \lim\limits_{n \to \infty}f'_x\left(\dfrac{1}{n^2},\dfrac{1}{n}\right) = \lim\limits_{n \to \infty}\dfrac{\sqrt{n}}{2} = +\infty \)，

知\( f'_x(x,y) \)在点\( P_0 \)的邻域内无界.

对于选项B:可求得\( f'_x(0,0)=f'_y(0,0)=0 \).由于

\( \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{f(x,y)-f(0,0)-\left[f'_x(0,0)x + f'_y(0,0)y\right]}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} = \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{|xy|}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} \).

而

\( 0 \leqslant \dfrac{|xy|}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} \leqslant |y| \)，\( \lim\limits_{y \to 0}|y|=0 \)，

故

\( \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{|xy|}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} = 0 \)，

从而\( f(x,y)=|xy| \)在点\( P_0(0,0) \)处可微.

对于选项C:可求得\( f'_x(0,0)=f'_y(0,0)=0 \).由于

\( \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{f(x,y)-f(0,0)-\left[f'_x(0,0)x + f'_y(0,0)y\right]}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} = \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{\sqrt[3]{xy}}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} \)不存在

（因取\( y=kx \)，\( \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y=kx \to 0}}\dfrac{\sqrt[3]{x \cdot kx}}{\sqrt{x^2+k^2x^2}} = \lim\limits_{x \to 0}\dfrac{\sqrt[3]{k}x^{\frac{2}{3}}}{|x|\sqrt{1+k^2}} \to \infty \)），

故\( f(x,y)=\sqrt[3]{xy} \)在点\( P_0(0,0) \)处不可微.由

\( f'_x(x,y)=\dfrac{1}{3}\left(\dfrac{y}{x^2}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} \)，\( \lim\limits_{n \to \infty}f'_x\left(\dfrac{1}{n},\dfrac{1}{n}\right) = \lim\limits_{n \to \infty}\dfrac{1}{3}\left(\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{n}}{\dfrac{1}{n^2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}} = \lim\limits_{n \to \infty}\dfrac{1}{3}n^{\frac{1}{3}} \to \infty \)，

知\( f'_x(x,y) \)在点\( P_0 \)的邻域内无界.

综上，选项A,B,C可排除，只能选D.

对于选项D:可求得\( f'_x(0,0)=f'_y(0,0)=0 \).由于

\( \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{f(x,y)-f(0,0)-\left[f'_x(0,0)x + f'_y(0,0)y\right]}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} = \lim\limits_{\substack{x \to 0 \\ y \to 0}}\dfrac{xy}{x^2+y^2} \)不存在(取\( y=kx \)).

故\( f(x,y) \)在点\( P_0(0,0) \)处不可微.当\( x^2+y^2 \neq 0 \)时，

\( f'_x(x,y)=\dfrac{y}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} - \dfrac{x^2y}{\sqrt{(x^2+y^2)^3}} \).

利用不等式

\( \left|\dfrac{xy}{x^2+y^2}\right| \leqslant \dfrac{1}{2} \)，\( |f'_x(x,y)| \leqslant \dfrac{|y|}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} + \dfrac{|xy|}{x^2+y^2} \cdot \dfrac{|x|}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}} \leqslant \dfrac{3}{2} \)，

知\( f'_x(x,y) \)在点\( P_0 \)的邻域内有界.

questions.answer: B
questions.explanation:
解析 当$x≠0$时，

$f(x)=\int_{0}^{1}\ln(x^{2}+t^{2})dt=t\ln(x^{2}+t^{2})|_{0}^{1}-\int_{0}^{1}\frac{2t^{2}}{x^{2}+t^{2}}dt$

$=\ln(1+x^{2})-2+2x\arctan\frac{1}{x}$.

$f(0)=\int_{0}^{1}\ln t^{2}dt=2\int_{0}^{1}\ln tdt=2t\ln t|_{0}^{1}-2=-2$.

由$\lim\limits_{x→0}f(x)=\lim\limits_{x→0}\left[\ln(1+x^{2})-2+2x\arctan\frac{1}{x}\right]=-2$，知$f(x)$在$x=0$处连续.

$\ln(1+x^{2})-2$在$x=0$处可导，记$g(x)=\begin{cases}2x\arctan\frac{1}{x},&x≠0,\\0,&x=0,\end{cases}$则

$f(x)=g(x)+\ln(1+x^{2})-2$.

则

$\lim\limits_{x→0^{+}}\frac{g(x)-g(0)}{x-0}=\lim\limits_{x→0^{+}}2\arctan\frac{1}{x}=π$，

$\lim\limits_{x→0^{-}}\frac{g(x)-g(0)}{x-0}=\lim\limits_{x→0^{-}}2\arctan\frac{1}{x}=-π$，

故$g'(0)$不存在，从而$f'(0)$不存在.

选项 B 正确.

questions.stem: 设$f(x,y)$为连续函数，且$f(x,y)=2x\iint_{D_1}f(x,y)dxdy + y\iint_{D_2}f(x,y)dxdy + 2$，其中$D_1$由$y=x$，$x=1$及$x$轴所围成，$D_2$由$y=x$，$y=1$及$y$轴所围成，则$f(x,y)=$
questions.answer: B
questions.explanation:
解析 设$\iint_{D_1}f(x,y)dxdy = A$，$\iint_{D_2}f(x,y)dxdy = B$，则$f(x,y) = 2Ax + By + 2$。等式两边同时在$D_1 \cup D_2$上进行二重积分，有

$\iint_{D_1 \cup D_2} f(x,y)dxdy = A + B = 2A \iint_{D_1 \cup D_2} xdxdy + B \iint_{D_1 \cup D_2} ydxdy + 2 \iint_{D_1 \cup D_2} dxdy$

$= 2A \iint_{D_1 \cup D_2} xdxdy + B \iint_{D_1 \cup D_2} xdxdy + 2$

$= (2A + B)\int_{0}^{1} xdx \int_{0}^{1} dy + 2 = A + \frac{B}{2} + 2$.

解得$B = 4$，故$f(x,y) = 2Ax + 4y + 2$. 对其两边同时在$D_1$上进行二重积分，有

$A = \iint_{D_1}(2Ax + 4y + 2)dxdy = 2\int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{0}^{x} (Ax + 2y + 1)dy$

$= 2\int_{0}^{1}(Axy + y^2 + y)\big|_{0}^{x} dx = 2\int_{0}^{1}[(A + 1)x^2 + x] dx$

$= \left[\frac{2(A + 1)x^3}{3} + x^2\right]\big|_{0}^{1} = \frac{2A + 5}{3}$，

解得$A = 5$，故$f(x,y) = 10x + 4y + 2$.

questions.stem: 设$f(x)$在$(0,+\infty)$内连续且严格单调递增，记$F(x)=\int_{1}^{x}f\left(\frac{t}{x}\right)dt - \int_{1}^{x}f\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)dt$，则
questions.answer: D
questions.explanation:
解析 令$\frac{t}{x}=u$，则

$F(x)=\int_{1}^{1}f(u)xdu - \int_{1}^{x}f\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)dt = -x\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}f(t)dt - \int_{1}^{x}f\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)dt$，

$F'(x)=-\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}f(t)dt - xf\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right) - f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)=\left(\frac{1}{x} - 1\right)f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) - \int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}f(t)dt$

$=\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)dt - \int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}f(t)dt = \int_{1}^{\frac{1}{x}}\left[f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) - f(t)\right]dt$.

当$0 < x < 1$时，$\frac{1}{x} > 1$，$1 < t < \frac{1}{x}$，$f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) - f(t) > 0$；

当$x > 1$时，$0 < \frac{1}{x} < 1$，$\frac{1}{x} < t < 1$，$f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) - f(t) < 0$.

故当$x > 0$且$x \neq 1$时，$F'(x) > 0$，$F'(1) = 0$. 因此$F(x)$在$(0,+\infty)$内单调递增.

选项D正确.

questions.stem: 设\( A^T = (\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \cdots, \alpha_{n-1}) \)是\( n \times (n-1) \)矩阵，\( r(A^T) = n-1 \)，\( \beta_1, \beta_2 \)是与\( \alpha_1, \alpha_2, \cdots, \alpha_{n-1} \)均正交的\( n \)维列向量，\( \beta_1 \neq \beta_2 \)，\( k \)是任意常数，则方程组\( AX = 0 \)的通解为
questions.answer: D
questions.explanation:
解析 由已知，\( A \)是\( (n-1) \times n \)矩阵，且\( r(A) = r(A^T) = n-1 \)，故\( AX = 0 \)的基础解系有\( n - r(A) = 1 \)个向量.

又因\( \beta_1, \beta_2 \)与\( \alpha_1, \alpha_2, \cdots, \alpha_{n-1} \)均正交，即\( \alpha_i^T\beta_1 = 0, \alpha_i^T\beta_2 = 0(i = 1,2,\cdots, n-1) \)，故

\[

A\beta_j = \begin{pmatrix}

\alpha_1^T \\

\alpha_2^T \\

\vdots \\

\alpha_{n-1}^T

\end{pmatrix} \beta_j = \begin{pmatrix}

0 \\

0 \\

\vdots \\

0

\end{pmatrix} \quad (j = 1,2),

\]

即\( \beta_1, \beta_2 \)是\( AX = 0 \)的两个不同解，从而\( \beta_1 - \beta_2 \)是\( AX = 0 \)的非零解. 故\( AX = 0 \)的通解为\( k(\beta_1 - \beta_2) \). 选项 D 正确.

由于\( \beta_1, \beta_2 \)可能为零向量，\( \beta_1 + \beta_2 \)也可能是零向量，所以排除选项 A,B,C.

questions.stem: 设2阶矩阵\( A = \begin{pmatrix} -1 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{pmatrix} \)，2维非零实列向量\( \boxed{\alpha} = (a,b)^{\mathrm{T}} \)，则二次型\( f(x_1,x_2,x_3) = \boxed{X}^{\mathrm{T}} \begin{pmatrix} A + \boxed{\alpha}\boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & \boxed{\alpha} \\ \boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & 1 \end{pmatrix} \boxed{X} \)的规范形为
questions.answer: C
questions.explanation:
解析 由

\[

\begin{pmatrix} E & \boxed{0} \\ -\boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & 1 \end{pmatrix}^{\mathrm{T}} \begin{pmatrix} A + \boxed{\alpha}\boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & \boxed{\alpha} \\ \boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & 1 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} E & \boxed{0} \\ -\boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} E & -\boxed{\alpha} \\ \boxed{0} & 1 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} A + \boxed{\alpha}\boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & \boxed{\alpha} \\ \boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & 1 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} E & \boxed{0} \\ -\boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & 1 \end{pmatrix},

\]

\[

= \begin{pmatrix} E & -\boxed{\alpha} \\ \boxed{0} & 1 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} A & \boxed{\alpha} \\ \boxed{0} & 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} A & \boxed{0} \\ \boxed{0} & 1 \end{pmatrix} \stackrel{\text{记}}{=} B,

\]

知\( \begin{pmatrix} A + \boxed{\alpha}\boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & \boxed{\alpha} \\ \boxed{\alpha}^{\mathrm{T}} & 1 \end{pmatrix} \)与\( B \)合同，故有相同的正、负惯性指数.

又由

\[

|\lambda E - B| = \begin{vmatrix} \lambda + 1 & -1 & 0 \\ -1 & \lambda - 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & \lambda - 1 \end{vmatrix} = (\lambda - 1)(\lambda^2 - 2),

\]

知\( f(x_1,x_2,x_3) \)的正惯性指数\( p = 2 \)，负惯性指数\( q = 1 \).

故其规范形为\( y_1^2 + y_2^2 - y_3^2 \).选项 C 正确.

【注】 此题也可以对\( \boxed{\alpha} = (a,b)^{\mathrm{T}} \)取特殊值，如取\( \boxed{\alpha} = (0,1)^{\mathrm{T}} \)，代入\( f(x_1,x_2,x_3) \)，求其正、负惯性指数.

questions.stem: 设A,B,C均为n阶实矩阵，\( A^T = A \)，若对任意n维非零列向量X，都有\( \text{tr}(ABXX^T) + \text{tr}(XX^T AB) > 0 \)。矩阵\( \begin{pmatrix} AB & O \\ B & BC \end{pmatrix} \)，\( \begin{pmatrix} B & A \\ O & AC \end{pmatrix} \)，\( \begin{pmatrix} A & C \\ O & AB \end{pmatrix} \)的秩依次为\( r_1, r_2, r_3 \)，则
questions.answer: C
questions.explanation:
解析 由于 \( \text{tr}(ABXX^T) + \text{tr}(XX^T AB) = \text{tr}[(ABX)X^T] + \text{tr}[(XX^T AB)^T] \)

\( = \text{tr}(X^T ABX) + \text{tr}(B^T AXX^T) \)

\( = \text{tr}(X^T ABX) + \text{tr}(X^T B^T AX) \)

\( = X^T ABX + X^T B^T AX \)

\( = (A^T X)^T (BX) + (BX)^T (AX) \)

\( = (AX)^T (BX) + (BX)^T (AX) \)

\( = 2(AX)^T (BX) > 0 \)，

即 \( \forall X \neq 0 \)，有\( (AX)^T (BX) > 0 \)，所以\( AX \neq 0, BX \neq 0 \)。

故A,B均可逆，从而AB也可逆.

\( r_1 = \text{r}\begin{pmatrix} AB & O \\ B & BC \end{pmatrix} = \text{r}(AB) + \text{r}(BC) = n + \text{r}(C) \)，

\( r_2 = \text{r}\begin{pmatrix} B & A \\ O & AC \end{pmatrix} = \text{r}(B) + \text{r}(AC) = n + \text{r}(C) \)，

\( r_3 = \text{r}\begin{pmatrix} A & C \\ O & AB \end{pmatrix} = \text{r}(A) + \text{r}(AB) = n + n = 2n \).

由于\( \text{r}(C) \leqslant n \)，所以有\( r_3 \geqslant r_1 = r_2 \). 选项C正确.

questions.stem: （填空题）设$f(x)$在$x=0$处连续，且$\lim\limits_{x \to 0}\frac{x^2[1+f(x)]}{x - \sin x}=6$，则曲线$y=f(x)$在点$(0,f(0))$处的切线方程为______。
questions.answer:
$y = x - 1$

解析 由$\lim\limits_{x \to 0}\frac{x^2[1+f(x)]}{x - \sin x}=6$，知

$x^2[1+f(x)]=(x - \sin x)[6 + \alpha(x)]$，$\alpha(x) \to 0$（$x \to 0$），

故

$\lim\limits_{x \to 0}[1+f(x)] = \lim\limits_{x \to 0}\frac{(x - \sin x)[6 + \alpha(x)]}{x^2}=0$。

由$f(x)$在$x=0$处连续，知$\lim\limits_{x \to 0}f(x)=f(0)=-1$，故

$f'(0)=\lim\limits_{x \to 0}\frac{f(x)-f(0)}{x - 0}=\lim\limits_{x \to 0}\frac{f(x)+1}{x}=\lim\limits_{x \to 0}\frac{(x - \sin x)[6 + \alpha(x)]}{x^3}=1$。

所求切线方程为$y - f(0)=x - 0$，即$y = x - 1$。

questions.stem: （填空题）$\lim\limits_{n \to \infty} \sum_{k=1}^{n} \int_{k}^{k+1} e^{-\sqrt{x}} dx =$ ______．
questions.answer:
$4e^{-1}$

解析 记$a_n = \sum_{k=1}^{n} \int_{k}^{k+1} e^{-\sqrt{x}} dx$，则$a_n = \int_{1}^{+\infty} e^{-\sqrt{x}} dx$．

故

$\lim\limits_{n \to \infty} a_n = \int_{1}^{+\infty} e^{-\sqrt{x}} dx \stackrel{\sqrt{x} = t}{=} \int_{1}^{+\infty} 2t e^{-t} dt$

$= -2 \int_{1}^{+\infty} t d(e^{-t}) = -2t e^{-t} \big|_{1}^{+\infty} + 2 \int_{1}^{+\infty} e^{-t} dt$

$= 2e^{-1} + 2e^{-1} = 4e^{-1}$．

questions.stem: （填空题）设二阶常系数线性非齐次微分方程 \( y'' + ay' + by = c\text{e}^x \) 的一个特解为 \( y = \text{e}^{2x} + (1 + x)\text{e}^x \)，则该方程的通解为______。
questions.answer:
\( y = C_1\text{e}^x + C_2\text{e}^{2x} + x\text{e}^x \)（\( C_1,C_2 \) 为任意常数）

解析 将 \( y = \text{e}^{2x} + (1 + x)\text{e}^x \) 代入已知方程，可得

\( (4 + 2a + b)\text{e}^{2x} + (3 + 2a + b)\text{e}^x + (1 + a + b)x\text{e}^x = c\text{e}^x \)。

故由方程组 \( \begin{cases} 4 + 2a + b = 0, \\ 3 + 2a + b = c, \\ 1 + a + b = 0, \end{cases} \) 解得 \( a = -3, b = 2, c = -1 \)。

原方程为 \( y'' - 3y' + 2y = -\text{e}^x \)。其对应的特征方程为 \( r^2 - 3r + 2 = 0 \)，解得 \( r_1 = 1, r_2 = 2 \)。

故所求通解为

\( y = C_1'\text{e}^x + C_2'\text{e}^{2x} + \text{e}^{2x} + (1 + x)\text{e}^x \)

\( = C_1\text{e}^x + C_2\text{e}^{2x} + x\text{e}^x \)（\( C_1,C_2 \) 为任意常数），

其中 \( C_1 = 1 + C_1', C_2 = 1 + C_2' \)。

questions.stem: （填空题）设函数$F(u,v)$可微，$z=z(x,y)$由方程$F\left(x+\dfrac{z}{y},y+\dfrac{z}{x}\right)=0$确定，则$x\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial y}=$______．
questions.answer:
$z - xy$

解析 方程$F\left(x+\dfrac{z}{y},y+\dfrac{z}{x}\right)=0$，求全微分，得

$$

\begin{align*}

\mathrm{d}F&=F_1'\left(\mathrm{d}x - \dfrac{z}{y^2}\mathrm{d}y + \dfrac{1}{y}\mathrm{d}z\right) + F_2'\left(\mathrm{d}y - \dfrac{z}{x^2}\mathrm{d}x + \dfrac{1}{x}\mathrm{d}z\right)\\

&=\dfrac{x^2F_1' - zF_2'}{x^2}\mathrm{d}x + \dfrac{y^2F_2' - zF_1'}{y^2}\mathrm{d}y + \dfrac{xF_1' + yF_2'}{xy}\mathrm{d}z = 0,

\end{align*}

$$

解得

$$

\mathrm{d}z = -\dfrac{y(x^2F_1' - zF_2')}{x(xF_1' + yF_2')}\mathrm{d}x - \dfrac{x(y^2F_2' - zF_1')}{y(xF_1' + yF_2')}\mathrm{d}y,

$$

故

$$

\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial x} = -\dfrac{y(x^2F_1' - zF_2')}{x(xF_1' + yF_2')},\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\dfrac{x(y^2F_2' - zF_1')}{y(xF_1' + yF_2')},

$$

从而

$$

x\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y\dfrac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -\dfrac{y(x^2F_1' - zF_2') + x(y^2F_2' - zF_1')}{xF_1' + yF_2'} = z - xy.

$$

questions.stem: （填空题）已知线性方程组$\begin{cases} ax_1 + 3x_2 + x_3 = 1, \\ bx_1 + 2x_2 + x_3 = 2, \\ x_2 + 2x_3 = 3, \\ x_1 + 2x_2 + 3x_3 = 1 \end{cases}$有解，其中$a,b$为常数，若$\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ -1 & -2 & -3 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 1$，则$\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \underline{\quad\quad}$。
questions.answer:
1

解析 由线性方程组有解，可知

$\text{r}\begin{pmatrix} a & 3 & 1 \\ b & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix} = \text{r}\begin{pmatrix} a & 3 & 1 & 1 \\ b & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \end{pmatrix} \leqslant 3$，

因此

$\begin{vmatrix} a & 3 & 1 & 1 \\ b & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 0$，即$\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 0$。

由$\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 & -3 \\ -1 & -2 & -3 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 1$，可知$\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ -1 & -2 & -3 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = -1$，

故$\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \end{vmatrix} + \begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ -1 & -2 & -3 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 \end{vmatrix} = -\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = -1$，

因此

$\begin{vmatrix} a & b & 0 \\ 3 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = 1$。

questions.stem: （本题满分10分）设\( a(a > -1) \)为非零常数，\(\lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\int_{1}^{x} \left[(t + a)^{1 + \frac{1}{t}} - t^{1 + \frac{1}{t + a}}\right] dt}{x} = 1\)，求\( a \)的值.
questions.answer:
解析 由洛必达法则，有

\[

\begin{align*}

\lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} \frac{\int_{1}^{x} \left[(t + a)^{1 + \frac{1}{t}} - t^{1 + \frac{1}{t + a}}\right] dt}{x} &= \lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} \left[(x + a)^{1 + \frac{1}{x}} - x^{1 + \frac{1}{x + a}}\right] \\

&= \lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} \left\{x\left(\frac{a}{x} + 1\right)^{1 + \frac{1}{x}} - x \cdot x^{\frac{1}{x + a}}\right\} \\

&= \lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} x\left[x^{\frac{1}{x}}\left(\frac{a}{x} + 1\right)^{1 + \frac{1}{x}} - x^{\frac{1}{x + a}}\right] \\

&= \lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} x\left[x^{\frac{1}{x}}\left(\frac{a}{x} + 1\right)^{1 + \frac{1}{x}} - x^{\frac{1}{x}} \cdot x^{\frac{1}{x + a} - \frac{1}{x}}\right] \\

&= \lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} x^{\frac{1}{x}} \cdot x\left[\left(\frac{a}{x} + 1\right)^{1 + \frac{1}{x}} - \frac{1}{x^{\frac{a}{x(x + a)}}}\right] \\

&= \lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} x\left[\left(\frac{a}{x} + 1\right)^{1 + \frac{1}{x}} - \frac{1}{x^{\frac{a}{x(x + a)}}}\right] \ (\lim\limits_{x \to +\infty} x^{\frac{1}{x}} = 1).

\end{align*}

\]

令\(\frac{1}{x} = t\)，则

原式\(= \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{(1 + at)^{t + 1} - t^{\frac{at^2}{1 + at}}}{t} = \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \left[\frac{(1 + at)^{t + 1} - 1}{t} - \frac{t^{\frac{at^2}{1 + at}} - 1}{t}\right]\)，

又

\[

\begin{align*}

\lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{(1 + at)^{t + 1} - 1}{t} &= \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{\mathrm{e}^{(t + 1)\ln(1 + at)} - 1}{t} \\

&= \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{(1 + t)\ln(1 + at)}{t} = \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{\ln(1 + at)}{t} = a,

\end{align*}

\]

\[

\begin{align*}

\lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{t^{\frac{at^2}{1 + at}} - 1}{t} &= \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{\mathrm{e}^{\frac{at^2}{1 + at} \ln t} - 1}{t} = \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{at^2}{1 + at} \cdot \frac{\ln t}{t} = \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{\ln t}{\frac{1 + at}{at}} \\

&\stackrel{\text{洛必达法则}}{=} \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} \frac{1}{t} \cdot \left[-\frac{(at)^2}{a}\right] = \lim\limits_{t \to 0^{+}} (-at) = 0,

\end{align*}

\]

故原式\(= a - 0 = a = 1\)。

questions.stem:
（本题满分12分）设\( x^2 + y^2 = 1(x \geq 0, y \geq 0) \)与\( x + y + xy = 1 \)所围区域为\( D \)。

\( f(x,y)=\begin{cases}

x - y + 1, & x + y \leq 1, \\

\frac{(x + y)^2}{x^2 + y^2}, & x + y > 1.

\end{cases} \)

计算\( I = \iint_D f(x,y)dxdy \)。
questions.answer:
解析 由\( x + y + xy = 1 \)，得\( y = \frac{1 - x}{1 + x} \)，即\( y + 1 = \frac{2}{1 + x} \)，它是以\( x = -1, y = -1 \)为渐近线的双曲线，如图所示。

直线\( x + y = 1 \)将\( D \)分为\( D_1 \)与\( D_2 \)，故

\( I = \iint_{D_1} (x - y + 1)dxdy + \iint_{D_2} \frac{(x + y)^2}{x^2 + y^2}dxdy \stackrel{记}{=} I_1 + I_2 \)。

由于\( D_1 \)关于直线\( y = x \)对称，所以

\( \iint_{D_1} (x - y)dxdy = \frac{1}{2} \iint_{D_1} (x - y + y - x)dxdy = 0 \)。

\( I_1 = 0 + \iint_{D_1} dxdy = \int_0^1 dx \int_{\frac{1 - x}{1 + x}}^{1 - x} dy = \int_0^1 \left(1 - x - \frac{1 - x}{1 + x}\right) dx = \frac{3}{2} - 2\ln 2 \)，

\( I_2 = \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta \int_{\frac{1}{\cos\theta + \sin\theta}}^1 \frac{r^2(\cos\theta + \sin\theta)^2}{r^2} \cdot rdr \)

\( = \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (\cos\theta + \sin\theta)^2 \cdot \frac{1}{2}r^2 \bigg|_{\frac{1}{\cos\theta + \sin\theta}}^1 d\theta \)

\( = \frac{1}{2} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (\cos\theta + \sin\theta)^2 \left[1 - \frac{1}{(\cos\theta + \sin\theta)^2}\right] d\theta \)

\( = \frac{1}{2} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (1 + \sin 2\theta) d\theta - \frac{1}{2} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} d\theta = \frac{1}{2} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \sin 2\theta d\theta = \frac{1}{2} \)，

故\( I = I_1 + I_2 = \frac{3}{2} - 2\ln 2 + \frac{1}{2} = 2 - 2\ln 2 \)。

questions.stem:
（本题满分12分）设$f(x)$满足$(y - \mathrm{e}^{x - 1})\mathrm{d}x + \mathrm{d}y = 0$，$y(1) = 1$．

（Ⅰ）求$y = f(x)$的表达式；

（Ⅱ）设曲线$y = f(x)$与直线$y = \frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e} + \mathrm{e}^{-1})$所围图形为$D$，求$D$绕直线$x = 1$旋转所得旋转体的侧面积．
questions.answer:
解析 （Ⅰ）由$(y - \mathrm{e}^{x - 1})\mathrm{d}x + \mathrm{d}y = 0$，得$\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} + y = \mathrm{e}^{x - 1}$，则

$y = \mathrm{e}^{-\int \mathrm{d}x}\left(\int \mathrm{e}^{x - 1} \cdot \mathrm{e}^{\int \mathrm{d}x}\mathrm{d}x + C\right) = \mathrm{e}^{-x}\left(\int \mathrm{e}^{2x - 1}\mathrm{d}x + C\right) = \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{x - 1} + C\mathrm{e}^{-x}$．

由$y(1) = 1$，得$C = \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}$，故

$y = f(x) = \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{x - 1} + \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e} \cdot \mathrm{e}^{-x} = \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{x - 1} + \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{-(x - 1)}$．

（Ⅱ）曲线$y = \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{x - 1} + \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{-(x - 1)}$关于直线$x = 1$对称，所求侧面积可视为图形$D$在$x \geqslant 1$部分绕$x = 1$旋转所得旋转体的侧面积，如图所示．用微元法，有

$\mathrm{d}S_{\text{侧}} = 2\pi(x - 1)\mathrm{d}s = 2\pi(x - 1)\sqrt{1 + x_y'^2}\mathrm{d}y$． ①

由$y' + y = \mathrm{e}^{x - 1}$，得$x - 1 = \ln(y + y')$．

又 $y'^2 = \left\{\frac{1}{2}\left[\mathrm{e}^{x - 1} - \mathrm{e}^{-(x - 1)}\right]\right\}^2$

$= \frac{1}{4}\left[\mathrm{e}^{2(x - 1)} + \mathrm{e}^{-2(x - 1)} - 2\right]$

$= \frac{1}{4}\left[\mathrm{e}^{2(x - 1)} + \mathrm{e}^{-2(x - 1)} + 2 - 4\right]$

$= \frac{1}{4}\left[\mathrm{e}^{2(x - 1)} + \mathrm{e}^{-2(x - 1)} + 2\right] - 1$

$= \left[\frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{(x - 1)} + \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{e}^{-(x - 1)}\right]^2 - 1 = y^2 - 1$，

即$y'^2 = y^2 - 1$．

当$x \geqslant 1$时，$y^2 \geqslant 1$，$y' \geqslant 0$．故$y' = \sqrt{y^2 - 1}$，从而

$x - 1 = \ln(y + \sqrt{y^2 - 1})$，$x_y' = \left[\ln(y + \sqrt{y^2 - 1}) + 1\right]_y' = \frac{1}{\sqrt{y^2 - 1}}$．

将上述两式代入 ① 式并积分，有

$S_{\text{侧}} = \int_{1}^{\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e} + \mathrm{e}^{-1})} 2\pi\ln(y + \sqrt{y^2 - 1}) \cdot \sqrt{1 + \frac{1}{y^2 - 1}}\mathrm{d}y$

$= 2\pi\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e} + \mathrm{e}^{-1})} \ln(y + \sqrt{y^2 - 1}) \cdot \frac{y}{\sqrt{y^2 - 1}}\mathrm{d}y$

$= \pi\int_{1}^{\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e} + \mathrm{e}^{-1})} \ln(y + \sqrt{y^2 - 1})\mathrm{d}(2\sqrt{y^2 - 1})$

$= \pi\left[2\sqrt{y^2 - 1}\ln(y + \sqrt{y^2 - 1})\bigg|_{1}^{\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e} + \mathrm{e}^{-1})} - \int_{1}^{\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e} + \mathrm{e}^{-1})} 2\sqrt{y^2 - 1} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\sqrt{y^2 - 1}}\right]$

$= \pi(\mathrm{e} - \mathrm{e}^{-1}) - 2\pi\left[\frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{e} + \mathrm{e}^{-1}) - 1\right]$

$= 2\pi(1 - \mathrm{e}^{-1})$．

questions.stem:
（本题满分12分）设方程$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0$有形如$u = \varphi\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$的解，$\varphi(r)$有二阶导数，且$\varphi(1) = 0$，$\varphi'(1) = 1$．

求$\varphi\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$的表达式．
questions.answer:
解析 由$r = \frac{y}{x}$，$u = \varphi(r)$，有

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \varphi'(r)\frac{\partial r}{\partial x} = -\frac{y}{x^2}\varphi'(r)$， ①

$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} = \frac{y^2}{x^4}\varphi''(r) + \frac{2y}{x^3}\varphi'(r)$， ②

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \varphi'(r)\frac{\partial r}{\partial y} = \frac{1}{x}\varphi'(r)$， ③

$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = \frac{1}{x^2}\varphi''(r)$． ④

将②式、④式代入$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0$，得

$\frac{y^2}{x^4}\varphi''(r) + \frac{2y}{x^3}\varphi'(r) + \frac{1}{x^2}\varphi''(r) = 0$，

化简得

$\left(1 + \frac{y^2}{x^2}\right)\varphi''(r) + \frac{2y}{x}\varphi'(r) = 0$，

即

$(1 + r^2)\varphi''(r) + 2r\varphi'(r) = 0$， ⑤

这是可降阶的微分方程．令$\varphi'(r) = p$，$\varphi''(r) = p'$，代入⑤式得

$p' + \frac{2r}{1 + r^2}p = 0$，

$p = C_1\text{e}^{-\int \frac{2r}{1 + r^2}\text{d}r} = C_1(1 + r^2)^{-1}$，

故$\varphi'(r) = C_1(1 + r^2)^{-1}$，积分得

$\varphi(r) = \int \frac{C_1}{1 + r^2}\text{d}r = C_1\arctan r + C_2$．

由$\varphi(1) = 0$，$\varphi'(1) = 1$，得$C_1 = 2$，$C_2 = -\frac{\pi}{2}$．

故$\varphi\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = 2\arctan\frac{y}{x} - \frac{\pi}{2}$．

questions.stem:
（本题满分12分）设$f(x)$在$[a,b]$上二阶可导，$M=\max\limits_{x\in[a,b]}\{|f''(x)|\}$。证明：对任意$x\in(a,b)$，均有

$$\left|\frac{f(x)-f(a)}{x-a}-\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a}\right|\leqslant \frac{M}{2}(b-x).$$
questions.answer:
解析 令$F(t)=\frac{f(t)-f(a)}{t-a}$，则对任意$x\in(a,b)$，$F(t)$在$[x,b]$上二阶可导，且

$$F'(t)=\frac{(t-a)f'(t)-[f(t)-f(a)]}{(t-a)^2}.$$

由拉格朗日中值定理，知存在一点$c\in(x,b)$，使得$F(x)-F(b)=(x-b)F'(c)$，即

$$\frac{f(x)-f(a)}{x-a}-\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a}=(x-b)\frac{(c-a)f'(c)-[f(c)-f(a)]}{(c-a)^2}. \quad ①$$

令

$$G(t)=(t-a)f'(t)-[f(t)-f(a)],\ H(t)=(t-a)^2,$$

则$G(t)$和$H(t)$在$[a,c]$上可导，且

$$G'(t)=(t-a)f''(t),\ H'(t)=2(t-a).$$

由柯西中值定理，知存在一点$\xi\in(a,c)$，使得$\frac{G(c)-G(a)}{H(c)-H(a)}=\frac{G'(\xi)}{H'(\xi)}$，即

$$\frac{G(c)}{H(c)}=\frac{f''(\xi)}{2}. \quad ②$$

将②式代入①式，得

$$\frac{f(x)-f(a)}{x-a}-\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a}=\frac{1}{2}(x-b)f''(\xi),$$

故

$$\left|\frac{f(x)-f(a)}{x-a}-\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a}\right|=\left|\frac{1}{2}(x-b)f''(\xi)\right|\leqslant \frac{M}{2}(b-x).$$

questions.stem:
（本题满分12分）设3阶实对称矩阵\( A \)有二重特征值1，且\( (A - 4E)\alpha = 0 \)，其中\( E \)是单位矩阵，\( \alpha = (1,1,1)^{\text{T}} \).

（Ⅰ）求实对称矩阵\( A \)；

（Ⅱ）记\( X = (x_1, x_2, x_3)^{\text{T}} \)，利用正交变换将二次型\( f(x_1, x_2, x_3) = \begin{vmatrix} A & -X \\ X^{\text{T}} & 0 \end{vmatrix} \)化为标准形.
questions.answer:
解析 （Ⅰ）由\( (A - 4E)\alpha = 0 \)，即\( A\alpha = 4\alpha \)，知\( A \)有特征值4，记为\( \lambda_3 = 4 \)，并且\( \alpha_3 = \alpha = (1,1,1)^{\text{T}} \)为其特征向量.

设\( A \)的二重特征值\( \lambda_1 = \lambda_2 = 1 \)对应的特征向量为\( X = (x_1, x_2, x_3)^{\text{T}} \)，则

\( X^{\text{T}}\alpha = x_1 + x_2 + x_3 = 0 \)

解得

\( \alpha_1 = (-1,1,0)^{\text{T}} \)，\( \alpha_2 = (-1,-1,2)^{\text{T}} \).

将\( \alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3 \)（已正交）单位化，得

\( \gamma_1 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} \)，\( \gamma_2 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} \begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ -1 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} \)，\( \gamma_3 = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix} \).

令\( Q = (\gamma_1, \gamma_2, \gamma_3) \)，则\( Q^{-1}AQ = \Lambda = \text{diag}(1,1,4) \). 故

\( A = Q\Lambda Q^{-1} = Q\Lambda Q^{\text{T}} = \begin{pmatrix} -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \\ 0 & \frac{2}{\sqrt{6}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} -\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} & 0 \\ -\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} & -\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}} & \frac{2}{\sqrt{6}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \end{pmatrix} \)

\( = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 2 \end{pmatrix} \).

（Ⅱ）对分块矩阵\( \begin{pmatrix} A & -X \\ X^{\text{T}} & 0 \end{pmatrix} \)作初等列变换，将\( -X \)处化为0. 因

\( \begin{pmatrix} A & -X \\ X^{\text{T}} & 0 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} E & A^{-1}X \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} A & 0 \\ X^{\text{T}} & X^{\text{T}}A^{-1}X \end{pmatrix} \),

故

\( f(x_1, x_2, x_3) = \begin{vmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} A & -X \\ X^{\text{T}} & 0 \end{pmatrix} \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} A & -X \\ X^{\text{T}} & 0 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} E & A^{-1}X \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix} \end{vmatrix} \)

\( = \begin{vmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} \Lambda & -X \\ X^{\text{T}} & 0 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} E & A^{-1}X \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix} \end{vmatrix} \)

\( = \begin{vmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} \Lambda & 0 \\ X^{\text{T}} & X^{\text{T}}A^{-1}X \end{pmatrix} \end{vmatrix} \)

\( = |\Lambda| X^{\text{T}}\Lambda^{-1}X = X^{\text{T}}|A|A^{-1}X = X^{\text{T}}A^{*}X \),

即\( f(x_1, x_2, x_3) \)的矩阵为\( A^{*} \).

由（Ⅰ）知，正交矩阵\( Q \)的行列式\( |Q| = 1 \)，且

\( Q^{-1}AQ = \Lambda \),

故\( A = Q\Lambda Q^{-1} = Q\Lambda Q^{\text{T}} \)，从而有

\( Q^{\text{T}}A^{*}Q = Q^{\text{T}}(Q\Lambda Q^{\text{T}})^{*}Q = Q^{\text{T}}(Q^{*})^{\text{T}}\Lambda^{*}Q^{*}Q \)

\( = (Q^{*}Q)^{\text{T}}\Lambda^{*}(Q^{*}Q) = (|Q|E)^{\text{T}}\Lambda^{*}(|Q|E) \)

\( = E^{\text{T}}\Lambda^{*}E = \Lambda^{*} \).

由\( \Lambda = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 \end{pmatrix} \)计算可得\( \Lambda^{*} = \begin{pmatrix} 4 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix} \).

故所求正交变换为\( X = QY \)，\( f \)的标准形为\( 4y_1^2 + 4y_2^2 + y_3^2 \).
